item.name: Auth

request.description:
Expected: **201**. Creates a `User` (`role: PATIENT`, `emailVerified: false`) and sends a 6-digit OTP to the given email (valid for a limited time). No tokens are issued yet — call **Verify Email** next with the OTP to receive `accessToken`/`refreshToken`.

`patient` is optional; only `contactNumber` is accepted on it at registration time.

Expected: **201**. Confirms the OTP sent by **Register Patient**, marks the user verified, and returns `data: { accessToken, refreshToken, user, patient }` (also set as `accessToken`/`refreshToken` cookies). The test script saves both tokens as collection variables.

Expected: **200** with `data: { accessToken, refreshToken }` (also set as cookies).

Other outcomes:
- unknown email → 404
- `status: BLOCKED` → 403
- deleted account → 404
- Google-only account (no password set) → 400
- wrong password → 401
Expected: **200** with the logged-in user's profile. Requires `accessToken` (cookie or `Authorization: Bearer` header) — any authenticated role (ADMIN, DOCTOR, PATIENT, SUPER_ADMIN) may call this.

Expected: **200** with a new `data: { accessToken, refreshToken }` pair. Reads the `refreshToken` cookie set by login/register — Postman's cookie jar sends it automatically after a successful login in this same session, so no body is needed.
Expected: **200**. Sends a 6-digit OTP to the given email for use with **Reset Password**.
Expected: **200**. Verifies the OTP sent by **Forgot Password** and updates the account's password.

item.description: All seven credential-auth endpoints under `/api/v1/auth`. `Get Me` is gated by `auth(ADMIN, DOCTOR, PATIENT, SUPER_ADMIN)` — every role passes, so the gate really just means "authenticated". Password rule enforced by Zod on register/login/reset: min 8 chars, at least one lowercase, one uppercase, one digit, one special character.

item.name: Auth - Google

request.description:
Expected: **200**, returning the app's own `accessToken`/`refreshToken` (body + cookies).

Resolution order: (1) known `googleId` (matched by the stable `sub` claim), (2) an existing account with the same email gets linked (`googleId` set, `emailVerified` forced true; an existing password is preserved), (3) otherwise a new `PATIENT` user + `Patient` row is provisioned.

`idToken` must be a real Google ID token verified against `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` — see `GOOGLE-LOGIN-TESTING.md` in the repo for how to obtain one for manual testing.

item.description: ID-token verification only. The frontend runs Google Sign-In, gets an ID token, and POSTs it here; the server verifies it and issues its own JWTs. Google is never involved again after this call.

request.description: Expected: **200**. Any authenticated role. Uploads `profileImage` to Cloudinary, updates `user.imageUrl`/`imagePublicId`, and deletes the previous image from Cloudinary if one existed. Update the `src` path to a real image file on your machine before sending.

item.name: Doctor

request.description: Expected: **200**. `multipart/form-data`: `resume` (single file), `additionalFiles` (up to 10 files), and `data` — a **JSON string** (not a nested form field) matching `ApplyAsDoctorValidationZodSchema`. Creates a `User` (`role: DOCTOR`, random temp password, `needPasswordChange: true`) + `Doctor` row (`verificationStatus: PENDING`), uploads files to Cloudinary, and emails a 6-digit OTP (1 hour TTL) to the doctor's email for **Verify Doctor Email**.

Expected: **200**. Confirms the OTP emailed by **Apply As Doctor** and sets `user.emailVerified: true`. The application still needs admin approval (see **Approve Doctor**) before the doctor can log in and use doctor-only endpoints.

Expected: **200**. ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN only. `verificationStatus` is `"APPROVED"` or `"REJECTED"`; `rejectionReason` is required when rejecting. Requires the doctor to have already verified their email. Emails the doctor an approval/rejection notice.
Expected: **200**, paginated. ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN only. Every doctor regardless of verification status, with the linked `user` (password omitted).
Expected: **200**. DOCTOR only, updates the caller's own `Doctor` row. All fields optional.

Expected: **200**, paginated. No auth. `APPROVED`, non-deleted doctors that have at least one `PUBLISHED` schedule today which hasn't started yet and still has open slots. Each doctor includes their matching schedules for today.
Expected: **200**, paginated. No auth. Public doctor directory restricted to `APPROVED`, non-deleted doctors, with only patient-safe fields selected (no resume/review metadata/user relation).

Expected: **200**, or **404** if the doctor doesn't exist / isn't `APPROVED` / is deleted. No auth. Replace `{{doctorId}}` (or the path segment) with a real doctor id — grab one from **Get All Doctors (Public)**.

item.description: All `/api/v1/doctor` endpoints: the apply → verify-email → admin-approve onboarding flow, the admin/self-service management endpoints, and the unauthenticated public discovery endpoints (`/public/...`) patients use before logging in.

item.name: Schedule

request.description: Expected: **201**. DOCTOR only. `startDateTime`/`endDateTime` must fall on the same calendar day and the doctor may only have one schedule per day. Total slots are computed as `duration / 20 minutes`; `availableSlots` starts equal to `totalSlots`. Created as `status: DRAFT` — publish it separately.
Expected: **200**, paginated. DOCTOR only — the caller's own schedules, with booked appointments/patients included.
Expected: **200**, paginated. ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN only — every schedule across all doctors.
Expected: **200**, paginated, or **400** if `doctorId` is missing from the query. PATIENT only. Today's `PUBLISHED`, not-yet-started schedules with open slots, for the given `doctorId`.

Expected: **200**. DOCTOR only, on their own `DRAFT` schedule (or a `PUBLISHED` one with zero bookings so far). All fields optional; omitted fields keep their current value. Recomputes `totalSlots`/`availableSlots`.
Expected: **200**. DOCTOR only, on their own schedule. Flips `status` from `DRAFT` to `PUBLISHED`, making it visible/bookable to patients. Fails with 409 if already published.
Expected: **200**, or **404**. DOCTOR/ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN. Includes the owning doctor (subset of fields) and booked appointments with patients.
Expected: **200**. DOCTOR only, on their own schedule. Soft-deletes (`isDeleted: true`). Fails with 409 if it's `PUBLISHED` and already has bookings.

item.description: All `/api/v1/schedule` endpoints covering the doctor's create → publish → manage lifecycle, admin oversight, and the patient-facing today's-schedule lookup.

item.name: Appointment

exec: console.log("Open this bKash payment URL to complete checkout:", res.data.paymentUrl);

request.description: Expected: **200** with `data: { paymentUrl }` (bKash checkout URL) — the appointment is created as `PENDING` and only becomes `CONFIRMED` after the bKash payment callback fires. PATIENT only. Requires the schedule to be `PUBLISHED`, for today, not yet started, and to have open slots; the patient may not already have a pending/confirmed/ongoing appointment on it.
Expected: **200** with `data: { paymentUrl }`. PATIENT only. Re-initiates a bKash checkout for an existing `PENDING` appointment (e.g. if the first checkout was abandoned).

Expected: **200** with `data: { appointment, payment }`. PATIENT (own appointment)/ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN. Frees the schedule slot back up. If cancelled more than 1 hour before `startDateTime` and the payment was `PAID`, a bKash refund is issued automatically. Fails with 400 if already `CANCELLED`/`ONGOING`/`COMPLETED`.

Expected: **200**, redirect payload. No auth — this is the URL bKash itself redirects the patient's browser to after checkout (`status` is one of `success`/`failure`/`cancel`). On success it confirms the appointment, assigns a serial number/joining time, decrements `availableSlots`, marks the payment `PAID`, and emails a PDF invoice. Not meant to be called manually except to replay a bKash sandbox redirect.

Expected: **200**. DOCTOR only, on their own appointment. Enforces `CONFIRMED → ONGOING → COMPLETED` in order — `status` must be `"ONGOING"` or `"COMPLETED"` and must match the only legal next step for the appointment's current status.
Expected: **200**, paginated. PATIENT only — the caller's own appointments with doctor/schedule/payment included.
Expected: **200**, paginated. DOCTOR only — the caller's own appointments with patient/schedule/payment included.
Expected: **200**, paginated. ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN only — every appointment across all patients/doctors.
Expected: **200**, or **403** if a PATIENT/DOCTOR requests an appointment that isn't theirs. PATIENT/DOCTOR/ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN.

item.description: All `/api/v1/appointment` endpoints: booking (which kicks off a bKash payment), the bKash redirect callback, doctor-side status progression, cancellation/refund, and the role-scoped list/detail views.

item.name: Payment

request.description: Expected: **200**, paginated. PATIENT only — payments for the caller's own appointments.
Expected: **200**, paginated. ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN only — every payment record.
Expected: **200**, or **403** if a PATIENT requests a payment that isn't theirs. PATIENT (own)/ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN.

item.description: All `/api/v1/payment` endpoints — read-only views over the `Payment` records created by the bKash flow in Appointment.

item.name: Prescription

request.description: Expected: **201**. DOCTOR only, for an appointment they own that is `COMPLETED`. Generates a PDF and emails it to the patient. `medicines` needs at least one entry; `instructions` is optional per medicine.
Expected: **200**, or **404** if no prescription exists yet for that appointment. PATIENT/DOCTOR (own appointment)/ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN.

item.description: All `/api/v1/prescription` endpoints — written by the doctor once an appointment is COMPLETED (see Appointment → Update Appointment Status).

item.name: Analytics

request.description: Expected: **200**. PATIENT only. Counts of the caller's total/upcoming/completed/cancelled appointments plus total amount spent and total refunded.
Expected: **200**. DOCTOR only. Schedule counts (total/published) and appointment counts by status for the caller, plus net earnings and refunds.
Expected: **200**. ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN only. Platform-wide doctor/patient/appointment counts, verification-status breakdown, and total revenue/refunded.

item.description: All `/api/v1/analytics` endpoints — read-only aggregate dashboards, one per role.

item.name: Misc

request.description: Expected: **200**. Basic liveness check at `/`.
Expected: **200**. Fetches a fresh bKash grant token server-side (logged to the server console) to sanity-check the bKash sandbox credentials, then returns a generic welcome payload.
